# vendor/amodo

Unmodified copies of the files this repository uses from the corpus's own
repository, `amodo-power-experiments`, at commit
`73ffebeb8c8055cfa85b5edb59e5d26bb94f41c6`: the feature definitions
(`code/features.py`, `code/channel/`) and three of its results. `code/corpus.py`
checks every file against `SHA256SUMS` on import.
